en.title: Apple $295 Target Crashes
en.summary: The probability of Apple (AAPL) closing above $295 on June 9 plummeted by 92.3% to 2%, driven by news indicating setbacks in its self-driving car project and AI capabilities. The Waymo acquisition of Apple's proving ground and WSJ's report on Siri's "memory crunch" significantly dampened investor optimism.

WSJ reported Apple's Siri "meets the memory crunch".
Broader market concerns over inflation data.

en.bear_case: Confirmation of Project Titan's failure and Siri's AI limitations will continue to weigh on Apple's future growth narrative.
